name: Landgasthof Post
beschreibung: Landgasthof Post welcomes travelers to the idyllic alpine village of Bach in the Lech Valley, in the core of the Tyrolean Lech Nature Park. This heritage inn harmoniously pairs generations of warm hospitality with authentic alpine comfort. Cozy guest rooms finished in solid local timber feature private balconies overlooking the rugged Lechtal and Allgäu Alps. In the paneled dining rooms and sunny beer garden, guests savor robust Tyrolean specialties, wild game, and homemade pastries prepared with local farm ingredients. The celebrated Lechweg trail passes through the valley, while winter brings access to scenic local slopes and the vast ski arenas of Warth-Schröcken and Ski Arlberg.
kurzbeschreibung: Historic country inn in Bach in the pristine Tyrolean Lech Valley Nature Park featuring authentic regional dining.
